conversion.images: Raw-deflate CgBI; PNG filter reversal; Adam7 pass placement; BGRA to RGBA; nearest integer alpha unpremultiplication; PNG zlib encoding
conversion.standard_png: butterfly.png is standard RGBA16; rounded to RGBA8 for consistent runtime decoding
conversion.image_limits: No resampling. Source is premultiplied 8-bit; original straight colors lost during premultiplication cannot be recovered exactly. Alpha-zero RGB is set to zero.
conversion.audio: Decode mono 44100 Hz Apple IMA4 ADPCM to PCM signed 16-bit WAV using macOS afconvert; independently compare every sample
conversion.fonts: Three original BMFont text files copied exactly, with original atlas PNGs converted. No system fonts copied.
